name: Have you taken user needs into account when making security decisions?
conditionsText:
This applies when designing:
- Authentication processes
- Access controls
- User journeys
- Security policies
- Business processes
requirementTitle: Have you taken user needs into account when making security decisions?
requirementDescription: Have you considered how real users will interact with security controls and whether those controls are practical and usable?
why:
Poorly designed security controls often lead users to:
- Work around the controls
- Circumvent processes
- Make mistakes
- Become frustrated
tasks: Security requirements were balanced against usability.
Controls were designed around how users actually work.
